description: A link your person can open: floor (the live floor: who's on a call right now, and recent calls); human_line (Human line: your mobile and live bridge calls); herman (the app home, with Herman in the corner); campaigns (campaigns); companies (companies found and researched); integrations (phone numbers, texting registration, Salesforce and Google); billing (credits, billing and the Outbound Compliance Agreement); team (members and invites); api_keys (API keys and agent connections (revoke here)). "floor" is the live floor to watch calls. (No API key needed.)
